newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Kerry Prop says Sham Tseng plan approved.
newsitem.headline: Kerry Prop says Sham Tseng plan approved.

text.p: Kerry Properties Ltd said on Monday its revised plans for the redevelopment of its Sham Tseng site in the New Territories had been approved by the government's Town Planning Board.
Kerry said it plans to build three 51- to 53-storey residential towers with a total floor area of about 500,000 square feet.
The project, with 560 units ranging from 700 to 1,200 square feet, is expected to be completed in 1999.
The company said it revised its original plan of building four 35-storey towers erected on top of a six-storey carpark.
